title: Annotatio IV §.XXI: superweight — most real though spiritual presence in German churches’ daily assent
pass_a_gloss: In this place, as a superweight of the doctrine and Faith concerning the presence of Christ’s body in the Sacred Supper — most real, though spiritual — we add to the Reformed’s public Confessions and private Doctors’ Writings, and even to any layman’s daily received and frequented assent in our German Churches, certain most efficacious Liturgical expressions, accustomed to be read both before and after the Sacred Supper administered among them in Germany, inserted also in the prayers to be poured out to God at this time, as follows.
pass_b_english: Here, as superweight for the most real though spiritual presence of Christ’s body in the Supper, add not only public confessions and private writings,
but the German churches’ daily lay assent — and the most efficacious liturgical expressions read before and after the Supper in Germany, inserted in the prayers of the hour.
source_text: Hộc locô in superpondium doctrinæ & Fidei de præsentia corporis Christi, in S. Cœna, realissima, utut spirituali, tam Confessionibus Reformatorum publicis, quàm privatorum Doctorum Scriptis, quin in Ecclesiis nostris Germanicis, Laici cujusvis adstipulationi quotidianæ, receptæ & frequentatæ, adjicimus efficacissimas quasdam expressiones Liturgicas, tàm ante, quam post administratam apud eos in Germania S. Cœnam, prælegi solitas, ipsis quoque precibus, ad Deum hoc tempore fundendis, insertas sequentes.
notes: German liturgy as superweight of real spiritual presence.
